mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month TIPS yield indicates a flattening yield curve, which lowers the real discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the 3-month TIPS yield signals steepening of the yield curve, which raises the real discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in steepening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs signals weakening labor market conditions, which raises uncertainty about corporate earnings and consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 112.6889 signals robust manufacturing activity, which lowers real discount rates and increases expected corporate cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) falling below 112.6889 signals weak manufacturing activity, which raises real discount rates and reduces expected corporate cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1474.0 units signals stronger consumer demand, which lowers real discount rates and increases expected corporate cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-month rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1474.0 units signals weak consumer demand, which raises real discount rates and reduces expected corporate cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-month rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
